tracks.title: Breath Between The Worlds
tracks.note: The liminal rhythm where inhale becomes exhale, and two dimensions press softly together at the seam.

tracks.title: Celestia I
tracks.note: First passage through the outer vault — light bending around ancient stars as consciousness unfolds toward the infinite.

tracks.title: Celestia II
tracks.note: The second arc deeper into luminous fields, where the sky forgets its own edges and becomes pure frequency.

tracks.title: Driving 111
tracks.note: A hypnotic pulse through infinite corridors of neon and stardust, where velocity itself becomes a form of meditation.

tracks.title: Eros Orchard
tracks.note: A garden blooming at the edge of desire and creation, where sacred fruit falls upward into the arms of the cosmos.

tracks.title: In reach of meaning
tracks.note: Fingers outstretched toward the ineffable — that trembling, suspended moment just before understanding arrives.

tracks.title: Knocking at Heaven
tracks.note: A gentle percussion against the membrane of the infinite, reverberating outward through galaxies waiting to open.

tracks.title: Kosmographica
tracks.note: The living atlas of the universe — each beat a continent, each melody a star system charted in pure sound.

tracks.title: Life is Vibration
tracks.note: The fundamental truth humming beneath all matter — atoms, minds, and stars all singing the same secret frequency.

tracks.title: Light in mind
tracks.note: Photons threading through neural corridors, illuminating the vast interior landscape of awareness one synapse at a time.

tracks.title: Maxsoft
tracks.note: Texture at the threshold of touch and thought — the softest frequency the cosmos can whisper without dissolving into silence.

tracks.title: Nondualizer
tracks.note: A sonic dissolution of all boundaries, where subject and object merge into a single, seamless, flowing field.

tracks.title: On The Temple Roof
tracks.note: Above the sacred chamber, the stars press close enough to hear — devotion rising like incense smoke into the dark.

tracks.title: Orbitron
tracks.note: A precise and eternal mechanical orbit, gears turning inside planets turning inside the great clockwork of galaxies.

tracks.title: Outworld
tracks.note: Beyond the edge of every map, where frequency becomes geography and sound becomes the terrain of unexplored dimensions.

tracks.title: Panentheon
tracks.note: A pantheon that holds all worlds within it — every deity a frequency, every prayer a waveform returned as melody.

tracks.title: Putting down
tracks.note: The sacred art of release — setting down the weight of accumulated time and drifting into weightless, boundless presence.

tracks.title: Rainbow Arrows
tracks.note: Chromatic shafts of light launched across the sky, each wavelength a different prayer finding its mark in the dark.

tracks.title: Rewinding Time
tracks.note: The tape unspools backward through memory, through birth, through stardust and the first silence before the first sound.

tracks.title: Signals from Somewhere
tracks.note: Transmissions arriving from coordinates unknown — meaning encoded in the luminous space between notes.

tracks.title: Starfields in Bloom
tracks.note: A garden of suns flowering across the dark, pollinated by wandering comets and the slow breath of cosmic wind.

tracks.title: Stone Circuits
tracks.note: Ancient architecture pulsing with electricity — the lithic and the digital converging across a billion years of time.

tracks.title: Stratomind
tracks.note: A mind expanded to the curvature of a stratosphere, dreaming in weather systems and tectonic whispers.

tracks.title: Textures of feelings
tracks.note: The tactile surface of emotion — each sensation a different fabric woven from the threads of lived light.

tracks.title: There is a voice in you
tracks.note: The inner resonance that never ceases — older than memory, quieter than silence, vaster than any sky.

tracks.title: 息がある。(Iki ga aru) — There is Breath
tracks.note: The Japanese art of breath as being — every exhalation a universe released, every inhalation a cosmos born.
